chapter: Los Angeles, Chico Hamilton and New York
title: Buddy Collette in New York and what Lloyd learned from him
summary: Newton asks about Collette's lessons and about Lloyd and Eric Dolphy as the horn players in Chico's group.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah! In ’62 with Mingus? Was it then?
Yeah, he came to do the Mingus stuff.
And something he was doing with - right, with Ella Fitzgerald, he was doing... yeah.
Can we go back to Buddy because...
There’s a couple of things that... Number one: Did you... I’m really curious as to the things, some of the things that you covered with Buddy in the lessons, and I also...

In your lessons with him, when you worked together. And I know a lot of it comes from conversation also, not just music. But that, and also when you and Eric first met, you know. Because it’s - in my mind, it’s really significant that the three of you were the horn players in Chico’s group, and you know, the three of you are like this great triumphing, you know. Just really, really incredibly exceptional, you know.
